name: Hyundai Bioscience Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai Bioscience Co., Ltd. is a biotechnology firm dedicated to creating and commercializing bio-fusion technologies that enable the precise delivery of active compounds throughout the human anatomy. The company offers Vitabrid C12, a novel vitamin C product engineered to provide active vitamin C directly to the skin. Additionally, it is advancing organic-inorganic hybrid technology, which functions as a sophisticated drug delivery system. This system integrates bio-friendly minerals to ensure the targeted and efficient transport of active substances to specific sites, a capability also leveraged in its anticancer drug carrier innovations. The enterprise was established in 2000 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
